title: Comparison of the two global constructible module sheaf predicates
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring and $F$ a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $X_{Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Then $\mathrm{IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf}(F)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf], the global finite-stratification definition with finite constant module values, is equivalent to the source library's $\mathrm{IsConstructibleSheaf}(F)$ for the concrete coefficient category $\mathrm{ModuleCat}(\Lambda)$: a finite constructible locally closed stratification [def-constructible-stratification] whose stratum pullbacks are locally constant with finitely generated geometric stalks [def-constructible-finite-locally-constant].

source.place: Definitions 095E (3), 03RU and 09XZ; the comparison is the stratumwise equivalence of lem-weil-pbc-finite-locally-constant-module-values, packaged over the identical global stratification records.

proof.text: Copy the partition, domains, immersions, immersion proofs and range equalities between LocallyClosedStratification and Scheme.Stratification. Their topological stratification fields coincide. The explicit constructibility condition is already a field of the topological record.

Apply the first equivalence of finite_locally_constant_module_values_iff to the pullback on each stratum, in each direction. Package the converted witnesses into the appropriate constructibility predicate.

theorem isConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf_iff
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) :
    IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf F ↔
      IsConstructibleSheaf (FA := fun M N : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ => M →ₗ[Λ] N)
        (CA := fun M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ => M) F
